idea-plugin.name: Theme Companion
idea-plugin.description:
A dark, high-contrast editor color scheme plus a folder-icon provider that guarantees directories marked as source, test, or resource roots always show their distinctive icon — never a blank or plain folder icon.

Built from real JetBrains Marketplace reviews of a paid theme plugin: folder icons for marked source/test directories disappearing after an update, and purchase popups shown to users who already have a paid license.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no forced UI redesign to opt out of. Turn it on the same way as any built-in theme: Settings > Appearance & Behavior > Appearance.
